author: Clijmart
body:
Looking for a team!

Skype: Clijmart
I use teamspeak quite often.
Can speak dutch and english.

Not a really high KD, mostly sneaking and rushing.
Kinda bad at pvp, but able to make a nice defence.

Timezone:
GMT+1, please don't invite me if I'm the only one with that timezone!

Team Experience:
I have been in Xenarch for around 2 days :P
I left because the difference in timezones wasn't fun for me.

Interests:
I like DTM the most and I try to make maps for that gamemode too.
